headline: Ferrari expected to bring a new floor to Austin
body: Ferrari is expected to run a new floor at the Circuit of the Americas as part of its fourth and final major upgrade of 2026, Motorsport.com understands. It aims to produce the same or more downforce while allowing a slightly less stiff set-up, which widens the car's operating window. Revised sidepods and bodywork may follow at the Mexican Grand Prix.

headline: Verstappen unveils a Texas-themed helmet for Austin
body: Max Verstappen has put a cowboy hat on the lion at the top of his helmet for the United States Grand Prix, keeping the red, white and blue scheme. He and Isack Hadjar will also wear white, vintage-style race suits. A matching all-white Red Bull livery has not been confirmed.
